method.primary_amount: lobby_amount_dedup_real_2025_usd (ruling 2026-09-25); $M = / 1e6. The undifferentiated amount is kept for the negative control and for comparison.
method.dedup_rule: For each member client (LobbyView lob_id) and filing year: if the client filed any self-filer report that year (reports.csv is_self_filer == 'true'), keep only its self-filer reports and drop the outside-firm reports filed for it that year; otherwise keep its outside-firm reports. The sector-year amount is the sum of the kept reports. Self-filer expenses already include payments to outside firms (OpenSecrets' method), so self-filer expenses and outside-firm income are never added. Accumulation: 0.0 plus each kept amount in reports.csv order, the source rule's arithmetic, so the value equals the undifferentiated amount bit for bit when no report is dropped (32 of 255 rows). dedup_ratio = dedup / undifferentiated, blank where the undifferentiated amount is 0.
method.amount_rule: collect_lobbyview.py _process_reports, reproduced exactly: stream reports.csv once in file order with the collector's csv settings and validations; skip a repeated report_uuid (none in this export); blank amount = 0.0; for every unique report of a member client add 1 to n_reports and the amount to amount_sum; finance subset = report_uuid in lobbyview_issue_index_finance.csv; inside it the self-filer subset and the hill subset; per_code counts in first-seen order.
method.deflation: real_2025 = nominal x 00_controls.xlsx multiplier_to_2025_dollars of the filing year (equal to the cpi_annual_2006_2025.csv value the data sheet uses, checked for every year both carry); blank before 2006.
method.status_build_note: the data sheet's rules: partial for filing year > 2023; notes for the 2024 sliver, the post-2021 finance undercount and the missing multiplier.
method.coverage_flag: ok / partial_year (2024) / thin (< 5 distinct reporting clients), joined by ';'.
method.primary_series: confidence != 'low' selects one row per study_sector x year: commercial_banks and credit_unions 'high', crypto and fintech 'roster', the five NAICS sectors 'naics'. commercial_banks 2024 has only a 'low' row (1 client, $0), as in the existing data.
method.rows_only_where_reports_exist: a sector-year without any report has no row (missing, never 0).

float_exactness.note: Both amounts use the source rule's float accumulation (0.0 plus each amount in reports.csv order); some report amounts carry cents, so a float sum can differ from the exact decimal sum in the last bits. Measured here.

dedup_ratio_medians_note: median over the sector's rows of dedup / undifferentiated; primary rows are confidence != 'low' (commercial_banks|low is the bank low tier, shown for completeness); 2006-2023 is the span with real dollars and full years; pooled = sum of dedup real / sum of undifferentiated real over 2006-2023.
